content.short: iMe App is a Telegram-based messenger with an integrated TON wallet and advanced DeFi features for social finance.
content.description: iMe App is a powerful alternative client for Telegram that seamlessly integrates a multi-chain crypto wallet, including full support for TON. It enhances the social messaging experience with decentralized finance (DeFi) tools, allowing users to send crypto directly in chats, participate in staking, and manage digital assets without leaving the app. By merging social communication with financial utility, iMe App is a leading example of SocialFi, bringing the TON ecosystem to Telegram's vast user base.
content.meta: Combine social messaging and DeFi with iMe App. Manage TON assets within Telegram on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
content.pageTitle: iMe App - Web3 Social Dapps - Lancers Web3 Explorer
